about: TG Path Tracing's in-game scenarios: which save shows what. tools/harness/Run-PtHarness.ps1 reads this; docs/PT-HARNESS.md explains it. save is the name the owner gives the save in the game's save menu; saveFallback is an older save of the owner's that stands in until that one exists (by its ID). where tells the owner where to stand for the save. roi is the part of the screen the scenario is about, as fractions (left, top, right, bottom): its crops and numbers are taken there.

scenarios.where: The fog save, the camera swinging 20 degrees to either side once every 4 seconds in a frozen world; the region is the screen's right edge, where the fog grid's cells come into view.
scenarios.tests: PT-118: whether the fog flickers in blocks at the screen's edge while the camera turns (a cell that comes into view has no history; RTX Remix gives it six samples and filters the cells, the tracer's grid does neither). Compare each traced step's change map and region with the old route's and with the game's own turning step.

scenarios.where: The vista save at 23:00: the village's and the castle's lamps 30 to 300 m off, in the dark, through the fog boxes.
scenarios.tests: PT-118: far lamps in the fog. Past 20 m the fog grid asks a lamp's light right by it (about 24 pixels around its image) only with a chance and weighs it one over that chance, with no history: whether far lamps' cores sparkle. Compare step 2's change map and region with step 1's around the lamps.

scenarios.where: Indoors by candle or fire light (Ron's Tavern), about one step from a person who stays put and has hair you can see. Face and hair in the middle of the screen.
scenarios.tests: a face up close by candle light: hair, eyebrows, lashes, eyes and skin where the light is warm and dim

scenarios.where: Ron's Tavern, from a corner or the door, so the whole room is in view: guests, tables, as many candles as fit, the haze.
scenarios.tests: an interior with many lights: the fill lights' haze, people at a distance (far hair), the exposure indoors, and the frame rate indoors

scenarios.where: The tavern-room save: a perfect mirror stood 1.6 m ahead, facing the camera, showing the room behind it.
scenarios.tests: PT-46: what the tracer shows in a perfect mirror against the game's own picture of the same view (tools/harness/mirror.py); textures.txt: what copies of the textures would cost (PT-45)

scenarios.where: The foggy-backdrop save (night, a torch, far hills through fog; there is no save named PT fog yet): a perfect mirror 1.6 m ahead, facing the camera, showing the fogged scene behind it.
scenarios.tests: the owner, 2026-10-08: "do the mirror demo ... so we can validate mirror reflections that include fog and stuff": the game's fog in a mirror against the game's own picture of the same view

scenarios.where: The water-day save: a perfect mirror 1.6 m ahead, turned 55 degrees, so that it shows the water and the shore to the side of the view.
scenarios.tests: the owner, 2026-10-08: "And mirror reflections with water": the tracer's water (its waves, its own reflection, the bed through it) in a mirror against the game's own picture of the same view

scenarios.where: The mineral cave save: a perfect mirror 1.6 m ahead, facing the camera, showing the cave behind it (glowing minerals, the lake if it lies there).
scenarios.tests: glowing minerals and a dark lake in a mirror against the game's own picture of the same view

scenarios.where: The npc-day save: a perfect mirror 0.8 m ahead, in front of the person, showing the daylight scene behind the camera.
scenarios.tests: PT-46 outdoors by day: sun, sky and far things in a perfect mirror against the game's own picture of the same view

scenarios.where: The cage with the thin bars (the owner's save is in the Crypt), standing where it boiled most, the crosshair on the bars.
scenarios.tests: boiling on thin bars and on the chairs around them

scenarios.where: Ron's Tavern, the shelf with the jars and bottles, one or two steps away, the jars in the middle of the screen.
scenarios.tests: glass you can see through: jars and their contents, bottles, the tint, labels, candles beside them

scenarios.where: A lit candle one or two steps away, its flame and the air above it in the middle of the screen, a wall or dark room behind it.
scenarios.tests: the smoke and gas around a candle flame: it boils, flickers and warps the air (PT-06)

scenarios.where: The candle corner of PT candle-boil, the camera turned up at the sky (the scenario sets the pitch; negative is up in this game).
scenarios.tests: what covers the candle corner in the traced scene and not in the game's picture (PT-39: the tracer finds 3 % of the open sky there)

scenarios.where: A glass jar one step away, in the middle of the screen, with something behind or inside it that the glass should bend.
scenarios.tests: refraction through a hollow glass jar: what is seen through it, its rim, its tint

scenarios.where: A floor where black spots flicker while tracing, looking down at it.
scenarios.tests: black spots that flicker on floors

scenarios.where: A glass bottle or flask standing on a table with a candle or the sun behind it, so its shadow falls on the table toward you. Close, looking down at the bottle and its shadow.
scenarios.tests: light focused through glass: the bright spot or line inside a bottle's shadow

scenarios.where: At the edge of clear, shallow water in sunlight, looking along the shore: the bed under the water near you, the far shore mirrored in the water, and if there is one, a rock, wall or bridge that faces the water.
scenarios.tests: water in sunlight: the ripple pattern on the bed, the reflection of the far shore, sunlight thrown back up by the water

scenarios.where: The water-day save at 18:30: a low sun, which water reflects most (13 % at 20 degrees up, 2 % at noon).
scenarios.tests: sunlight thrown up by rippling water onto what faces it (PT-14), with the Caustics row on and off

scenarios.where: The mineral cave turned round to its lake (an HDRP water surface 5.5 m behind the save's camera, docs/agents/caustics.md), looking a little down.
scenarios.tests: lamps and torches reflected off real water onto what faces it, rippling (PT-14), with the Caustics row on and off; the lake's own reflections

scenarios.where: The mineral cave turned round to its lake, as glow-lake, with the harness's lantern (Lantern.cs: the game's big torch's light and a glowing glass) 7 m ahead, 0.35 m over the water, 3 m short of the rock on the far side.
scenarios.tests: PT-14 in a dark cave: a lamp's light thrown by a lake onto the rock that faces it, with no shade and under a shade that keeps the lamp's own light off the rock, the Caustics row on and off, the Direct view, and the world running (anim)

scenarios.where: The owner's sea cave (PT water-torch) at 22:00, with the harness's lantern over the sea 3 to 4 m in front of the big rock that rises out of the water.
scenarios.tests: PT-14, the scene to show the owner: at night a lamp's light thrown by the sea onto the cave's rock, rippling; with no shade and under a shade, the Caustics row on and off, the Direct view, and the world running (anim)

scenarios.where: A pool or flooded floor in a cave or dungeon with a torch or brazier beside it, the water and the flame both in view.
scenarios.tests: water in the dark: a flame mirrored in it

scenarios.where: The door whose metal strap showed the saw-tooth pattern, one step away, the strap at the crosshair.
scenarios.tests: the saw-tooth pattern on a door's metal strap; reflections on rough metal

scenarios.where: Polished metal up close in good light: a guard in plate armour, an armour stand or a row of weapons, one or two steps away.
scenarios.tests: reflections on armour and metal (Reflection Boost), and on wet stone if there is some

scenarios.where: A very dark room lit by a single candle or torch (a crypt), the light and the darkest corner both in view.

scenarios.where: Inside a dark building or cave, looking out through a door or arch into daylight: the dark inside and the bright outside both in view.
scenarios.tests: the exposure with dark and bright in one view; daylight entering a dark room
